notes.title: New Region Added
notes.content:
There is now a new region that can be accessed in Tarsian Forest, called Orbiting Mass. New enemies are apearing in the region and a new weapon called the Laser Blaster can be discovered.

PATCH NOTES

-new weapon: Laser Pistol
-new region: Orbiting Mass
-new enemies: Moon Men, Big Heads, Borx
-updated skill tree
-revamped Enemy Gun attacks
-Sprint is now a toggle if not holding the Sprint button

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
There are now two new activities available.

There is a survival area in Tarsian Forest.
Survive for 2 minutes against a horde of enemies to obtain the sawed off shotgun.

There is now 2 Cloning Labs areas. 1 in Tarsian Forest and 1 in Lars Desert.
Fight against fast respawning enemies in a tight corridor and then defeat a handful of minibosses.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: I have updated and released a new updated demo of the game's first region, Tarsian Forest.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
CONTENT

-Events now appear in The Wicked and Lars Desert

BUG FIXES

-fixed combat events not spawning

-fixed grapple hook issues

-fixed barrels not having explosions

-fixed tornado secondary not firing

-added more fx to orb explosion mission

-fixed haunted house portal

-made catacombs portal more visible

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content: Hello everyone, thank you to all who downloaded and played the demo of Escape the Dead. The game is now released in Early Access. I spent most of my free time the past two years making this game. Enjoy the game and leave feedback.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
-Fishing available
-boost gardens are available
-Random Events will now appear around the map
-Card games are available in the town
-new animals
-added a skip tutorial portal
-new mini boss in Feldo Fields

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has downloaded and played the demo to Escape the Dead!
I have been working on this for almost 2 years now and I am happy to finally share it with everyone.
I will continue to update the demo at least once per month until the release. The demo will only include the first area and a few quests. Saving has been disabled to allow me to publish changes easier.
